speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as cloudiness, blood, or a foul odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any burning sensation when urinating, or have you passed any stones or clots recently? Also, did you experience nausea or vomiting alongside the fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: That reaction to both amoxicillin and cephalexin suggests a potential penicillin or cephalosporin allergy. Did you develop the rash specifically after starting these medications, or did it appear while you were taking them? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your face or lips?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of fever and flank pain, persisting after antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, strongly suggests a kidney infection that may have been missed or inadequately treated. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine_Culture. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count.
